axis: +Y up; +Z is the modeled broad landing and entrance-facing elevation, directed northeast (about 59 degrees true); +X faces northwest. The offset staircase/lightning cylinder lies west-northwest of the lantern. The separate narrow northwest podium access is outside this single-landing reconstruction.
geometryLabel: Mapped 12.7 m shaft envelope; signed axes chosen using the broad northeast landing and west-northwest stair cylinder, not from the rectangle alone.

orientationControl.basis: Inspected north-up OSM map and satellite view show a broad stepped landing to the northeast, a separate narrow northwest opening and the roof stair cylinder to the west/northwest of the central lantern. This chooses the 180-degree sign of the existing face axes. Aerial roof positions have relief displacement and are used for quadrant only, not surveyed offset coordinates.

heightControl.basis: Municipal dimensions and UNESCO distinguish lighthouse structure and supporting hill. The anomalous mapped height=1 tag is not a tower-height control.

limits: Signed quadrant is visually reconstructed from inspected north-up map/aerial access and roof layout, not surveyed camera or entrance azimuth. The square map envelope remains 12.7 m versus the published 11.75 m core; no XY stretch. Platform radius, parapet, minor openings, upper-stage allocation and fittings are photo-proportioned. Host terrain-contact Y=0 is a viewer convention, not the 57 m hill elevation or a surveyed tide/vertical datum. Excavated visitor annex, inscription edicule, separate northwest access, interiors and entire park are not included.
